self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: Day and Night in Counterpoint: every 10s the wielder cycles to the next Harmonic Movement — +18%/+36% ATK, then +120/+240 Elemental Mastery, then +28%/+56% Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG (R1/R5). Each lasts 10s and it works off-field. Triggering a Stellar Glimmer reaction grants a second 12s instance of whichever movement is active, stacking with it (12s ICD) — the "_contrapuntal" states are that doubled value. Pick the movement the scored damage window lands in, or "averaged" for a third of each, since the three cycle deterministically over 30s. Note that averaging stats is not the same as averaging damage; prefer naming the movement when the rotation is short enough to sit inside one. The Stellar Glimmer movement uses stellarglimmer_dmg_, the umbrella key covering both Stellar-Conduct and Stellar Swirl.

source.note: 7.0 weapon, added 2026-08-08 from nanoka 6.7.54 beta data (neither Amber nor GO carry it yet). Base stats derived as init x levels['90'] + last ascension add, the same derivation validated to the cent against 15 existing seed files. Buffs authored R1-in-states with an R5 refinementStates tier (2026-08-23), so a board can pick either; a 4* still defaults to R5, so resolved values are unchanged. R1 values cross-checked against GameWith/Icy Veins and are exactly half of R5.
